dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Hello! I'll get the materials needed today right away— Oh, it's you!

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: We meet again, Traveler. It's my pleasure.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: And no, that's not mere formality. Seeing you is like seeing a gear turning on an intricate axis within a clock — it's as if my life is still on the right track.
